title: Iran launches missile and drone attacks on Bahrain as tankers are hit in Hormuz
caption:
Iran launched missile and drone attacks on Bahrain on Saturday night, saying it targeted US military bases. Bahrain says it intercepted several attacks and that a civilian industrial site caught fire, with no injuries. Two tankers were also hit in the Strait of Hormuz, and an Iranian lawmaker says Tehran is preparing 14 tankers to break the US naval blockade.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
